verses.original: בְּ֭נִי אִם־ תִּקַּ֣ח אֲמָרָ֑י תִּצְפֹּ֥ן וּ֝מִצְוֺתַ֗י אִתָּֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·nî ’im- tiq·qaḥ ’ă·mā·rāy tiṣ·pōn ū·miṣ·wō·ṯay ’it·tāḵ
verses.literal: My son if you accept my words and hide my commandments within you

verses.original: לְהַקְשִׁ֣יב אָזְנֶ֑ךָ לַֽחָכְמָ֣ה תַּטֶּ֥ה לִ֝בְּךָ֗ לַתְּבוּנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lə·haq·šîḇ ’ā·zə·ne·ḵā la·ḥā·ḵə·māh taṭ·ṭeh lib·bə·ḵā lat·tə·ḇū·nāh
verses.literal: if you incline your ear to wisdom and direct your heart to understanding

verses.original: אִ֣ם כִּ֤י תִקְרָ֑א לַבִּינָ֣ה תִּתֵּ֥ן קוֹלֶֽךָ׃ לַ֝תְּבוּנָ֗ה
verses.transliteration: ’im kî ṯiq·rā lab·bî·nāh tit·tên qō·w·le·ḵā lat·tə·ḇū·nāh
verses.literal: if you truly call out to insight and lift your voice to understanding

verses.original: אִם־ תְּבַקְשֶׁ֥נָּה כַכָּ֑סֶף תַּחְפְּשֶֽׂנָּה׃ וְֽכַמַּטְמוֹנִ֥ים
verses.transliteration: ’im- tə·ḇaq·šen·nāh ḵak·kā·sep̄ taḥ·pə·śen·nāh wə·ḵam·maṭ·mō·w·nîm
verses.literal: if you seek it like silver and search it out like hidden treasure

verses.original: אָ֗ז תָּ֭בִין יִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה תִּמְצָֽא׃ וְדַ֖עַת אֱלֹהִ֣ים
verses.transliteration: ’āz tā·ḇîn yir·’aṯ Yah·weh tim·ṣā wə·ḏa·‘aṯ ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: then you will discern the fear of the LORD and discover the knowledge of God

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יְ֭הוָה יִתֵּ֣ן חָכְמָ֑ה מִ֝פִּ֗יו דַּ֣עַת וּתְבוּנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî- Yah·weh yit·tên ḥāḵ·māh mip·pîw da·‘aṯ ū·ṯə·ḇū·nāh
verses.literal: For the LORD gives wisdom from His mouth come knowledge and understanding

verses.original: וְצָפַן תּוּשִׁיָּ֑ה לַ֭יְשָׁרִים מָ֝גֵ֗ן לְהֹ֣לְכֵי תֹֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṣå̄·p̄an tū·šî·yāh lay·šā·rîm mā·ḡên lə·hō·lə·ḵê ṯōm
verses.literal: He stores up sound wisdom for the upright He is a shield to those who walk with integrity

verses.original: לִ֭נְצֹר אָרְח֣וֹת מִשְׁפָּ֑ט יִשְׁמֹֽר׃ וְדֶ֖רֶךְ חֲסִידוֹ
verses.transliteration: lin·ṣōr ’ā·rə·ḥō·wṯ miš·pāṭ yiš·mōr wə·ḏe·reḵ ḥă·sī·ḏō
verses.literal: to guard the paths of justice and protect the way of His saints

verses.original: אָ֗ז תָּ֭בִין צֶ֣דֶק וּמִשְׁפָּ֑ט וּ֝מֵישָׁרִ֗ים כָּל־ טֽוֹב׃ מַעְגַּל־
verses.transliteration: ’āz tā·ḇîn ṣe·ḏeq ū·miš·pāṭ ū·mê·šā·rîm kāl- ṭō·wḇ ma‘·gal-
verses.literal: Then you will discern righteousness and justice and equity every good path

verses.original: כִּֽי־ חָכְמָ֣ה תָב֣וֹא בְלִבֶּ֑ךָ וְ֝דַ֗עַת יִנְעָֽם׃ לְֽנַפְשְׁךָ֥
verses.transliteration: kî- ḥāḵ·māh ṯā·ḇō·w ḇə·lib·be·ḵā wə·ḏa·‘aṯ yin·‘ām lə·nap̄·šə·ḵā
verses.literal: For wisdom will enter your heart and knowledge will delight your soul

verses.original: מְ֭זִמָּה תִּשְׁמֹ֥ר עָלֶ֗יךָ תְּבוּנָ֥ה תִנְצְרֶֽכָּה׃
verses.transliteration: mə·zim·māh tiš·mōr ‘ā·le·ḵā tə·ḇū·nāh ṯin·ṣə·rek·kāh
verses.literal: Discretion will watch over you . . . and understanding will guard you

verses.original: לְ֭הַצִּ֣ילְךָ מִדֶּ֣רֶךְ רָ֑ע מֵ֝אִ֗ישׁ מְדַבֵּ֥ר תַּהְפֻּכֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: lə·haṣ·ṣî·lə·ḵā mid·de·reḵ rā‘ mê·’îš mə·ḏab·bêr tah·pu·ḵō·wṯ
verses.literal: to deliver you from the way of evil from the man who speaks perversity

verses.original: הַ֭עֹ֣זְבִים יֹ֑שֶׁר אָרְח֣וֹת לָ֝לֶ֗כֶת בְּדַרְכֵי־ חֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ha·‘ō·zə·ḇîm yō·šer ’ā·rə·ḥō·wṯ lā·le·ḵeṯ bə·ḏar·ḵê- ḥō·šeḵ
verses.literal: from those who leave the straight paths to walk in the ways of darkness

verses.original: הַ֭שְּׂמֵחִים לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת רָ֑ע יָ֝גִ֗ילוּ בְּֽתַהְפֻּכ֥וֹת רָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: haś·śə·mê·ḥîm la·‘ă·śō·wṯ rā‘ yā·ḡî·lū bə·ṯah·pu·ḵō·wṯ rā‘
verses.literal: from those who enjoy doing evil and rejoice in the twistedness of evil

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָרְחֹתֵיהֶ֣ם עִקְּשִׁ֑ים בְּמַעְגְּלוֹתָֽם׃ וּ֝נְלוֹזִ֗ים
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer ’ā·rə·ḥō·ṯê·hem ‘iq·qə·šîm bə·ma‘·gə·lō·w·ṯām ū·nə·lō·w·zîm
verses.literal: whose paths are crooked and whose ways are devious

verses.original: לְ֭הַצִּ֣ילְךָ זָרָ֑ה מֵאִשָּׁ֣ה מִ֝נָּכְרִיָּ֗ה הֶחֱלִֽיקָה׃ אֲמָרֶ֥יהָ
verses.transliteration: lə·haṣ·ṣî·lə·ḵā zā·rāh mê·’iš·šāh min·nā·ḵə·rî·yāh he·ḥĕ·lî·qāh ’ă·mā·re·hā
verses.literal: It will rescue you from the forbidden woman from the stranger with seductive words

verses.original: הַ֭עֹזֶבֶת אַלּ֣וּף נְעוּרֶ֑יהָ וְאֶת־ שָׁכֵֽחָה׃ בְּרִ֖ית אֱלֹהֶ֣יהָ
verses.transliteration: ha·‘ō·ze·ḇeṯ ’al·lūp̄ nə·‘ū·re·hā wə·’eṯ- šā·ḵê·ḥāh bə·rîṯ ’ĕ·lō·he·hā
verses.literal: who abandons the partner of her youth - and forgets the covenant of her God

verses.original: כִּ֤י בֵּיתָ֑הּ שָׁ֣חָה אֶל־ מָ֣וֶת מַעְגְּלֹתֶֽיהָ׃ וְאֶל־ רְ֝פָאִ֗ים
verses.transliteration: kî bê·ṯāh šā·ḥāh ’el- mā·weṯ ma‘·gə·lō·ṯe·hā wə·’el- rə·p̄ā·’îm
verses.literal: For her house sinks down to death and her tracks to the departed spirits

verses.original: כָּל־ בָּ֭אֶיהָ לֹ֣א יְשׁוּב֑וּן וְלֹֽא־ יַ֝שִּׂ֗יגוּ אָרְח֥וֹת חַיִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- bā·’e·hā lō yə·šū·ḇūn wə·lō- yaś·śî·ḡū ’ā·rə·ḥō·wṯ ḥay·yîm
verses.literal: None who go to her . . . return [or] negotiate the paths of life

verses.original: לְמַ֗עַן תֵּ֭לֵךְ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ טוֹבִ֑ים תִּשְׁמֹֽר׃ וְאָרְח֖וֹת צַדִּיקִ֣ים
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an tê·lêḵ bə·ḏe·reḵ ṭō·w·ḇîm tiš·mōr wə·’ā·rə·ḥō·wṯ ṣad·dî·qîm
verses.literal: So you will follow in the ways of the good and keep to the paths of the righteous

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יְשָׁרִ֥ים יִשְׁכְּנוּ אָ֑רֶץ וּ֝תְמִימִ֗ים יִוָּ֥תְרוּ בָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- yə·šā·rîm yiš·kə·nū ’ā·reṣ ū·ṯə·mî·mîm yiw·wā·ṯə·rū ḇāh
verses.literal: For the upright will inhabit the land and the blameless will remain in it

verses.original: וּ֭רְשָׁעִים יִכָּרֵ֑תוּ מִמֶּֽנָּה׃פ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ וּ֝בוֹגְדִ֗ים יִסְּח֥וּ
verses.transliteration: ū·rə·šā·‘îm yik·kā·rê·ṯū mim·men·nāh mê·’e·reṣ ū·ḇō·wḡ·ḏîm yis·sə·ḥū
verses.literal: but the wicked will be cut off from the land and the unfaithful {will} be uprooted
